purpose: Determine whether a seven-year SonotaCo virtual-year stack has sufficiently broad and stable support to authorize a survey-adapted implementation of the Brown et al. (2010) CMOR 3D wavelet search without weakening its published one-degree bins, 300-contributor floor, or three-point temporal-linking rule.

reference.title: A meteoroid stream survey using the Canadian Meteor Orbit Radar II: Identification of minor showers using a 3D wavelet transform

classification: multiyear input and exposure feasibility audit; not a wavelet comparator result

virtual_year.stacking_rule: raw concatenation into one virtual year, matching the published seven-year stacking concept; no coefficient or count is exposure-renormalized in this audit
virtual_year.archive_hash_policy: This source-only design is frozen before access. The audit discovers and records exact archive and member SHA-256 values; every later coefficient run must pin them.
virtual_year.member_selection: require exactly one annual CSV member matching */_U2_YYYY0101_S.csv in each archive

support_and_exposure_metrics: exact archive and member hashes and schemas by year
stacked retained events in every available one-degree bin
number of contributing years in every available bin
largest single-year share in every supported bin
fraction of bins meeting the necessary 300-total-event floor

authorization_gates.broad_total_support: at least 80 percent of available one-degree bins contain at least 300 retained events in the seven-year raw stack
authorization_gates.broad_multiyear_support: at least 80 percent of available bins contain at least one retained event in five or more of the seven years
authorization_gates.limited_single_year_dominance: among bins reaching 300 total events, no more than 10 percent have one year contributing more than 50 percent of the bin total
authorization_gates.temporal_coverage: at least 200 distinct forward three-point chains satisfy the published maximum two-degree gap

authorized_if_all_gates_pass: freeze the exact seven archives and write a separate coefficient-level protocol before any wavelet value is computed
prohibitions: Do not calculate a wavelet coefficient, local maximum, shower recovery, or comparison endpoint in this audit.
Do not read shower labels or OrbitTrace candidate values.
Do not replace raw seven-year stacking with post-result year weighting.

Do not lower the 300-radiant floor, reduce the five-of-seven exposure requirement, relax the 80-percent breadth gates, increase the 10-percent dominance allowance, or reduce the 200-chain gate after seeing the data.
Do not interpret a failed optical-input gate as evidence that the radar wavelet method performs poorly or that fixed4 wins.
claim_boundary: A pass authorizes only coefficient-protocol development. A failure means the available SonotaCo stack is not a fair global input for this published survey design. Neither outcome is a direct fixed4-versus-wavelet performance comparison.
